description: This Java source file defines the ContentServicesComplex class which provides services related to content and content association retrieval, primarily for OFBiz Content Management. It includes methods for querying entity views related to content associations, with filtering based on various parameters like dates, content types, association types, direction, and map keys.

classes.name: ContentServicesComplex
classes.description: Provides static methods for querying content associations, views, and resources within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getAssocAndContentAndDataResource
methods.description: Retrieves associations, content, and data resource views based on input parameters such as contentId, association types, content types, date ranges, and direction.

methods.name: getAssocAndContentAndDataResourceMethod
methods.description: Internal method performing the core query logic for associated content and data resources by building entity conditions and querying views.

methods.name: getAssocAndContentAndDataResourceCache
methods.description: Retrieves a cached version of associated content and data resources, allowing additional string-based filtering of association and content types.

methods.name: getAssocAndContentAndDataResourceCacheMethod
methods.description: Internal method executing complex filtered queries on content association views, processing related entities and applying ordering.
